title: Nursery Practitioner Level 2
description:
Role Overview:
Join Our Team at Busy Bees – Leading Nursery Group in the UK

As an Early Years Educator, you will play a leading role in fostering the intellectual, social, and emotional development of children at Busy Bees. Join a company that values high-quality education and provides ample growth opportunities.

About Us

Busy Bees is the UK's leading nursery group, with nearly 400 nurseries across the UK and more overseas. We are dedicated to giving every child the best start in life and are proud to have won awards for our workplace culture. Busy Bees Leicester Bitteswell, rated "Good" by Ofsted, is a vibrant nursery located in Lutterworth, approximately a 30-minute drive from central Leicester. • Our ‘Hive’ benefits and wellbeing hub, with discounts across a huge range of retailers

title: Roadside Technician - Wales
description:
Join the RAC as a Roadside Technician and solve problems that keep people moving.As a Roadside Technician, you'll benefit from:

• £36,400 base salary with a realistic OTE of £61,000, with top performers earning significantly more through bonus and enhanced overtime rates.
• Starting and finishing on your driveway, with demand-led shifts averaging 40 hours per week and optional overtime available.

• A structured development programme with hands-on learning, ongoing support and the opportunity to achieve accreditation through the motor industry's professional body, the IMI.
Opportunities in Wales:CardiffMerthyr TydfilSwansea

What you’ll need...
Either:

NVQ Level 2 qualification in Light Vehicle Maintenance (or equivalent) with 2+ years’ experience

or

5+ years’ experience as a Vehicle Technician/Mechanic

and

A full UK driving licence with fewer than 6 points
Investing in your technical development
At the RAC, we're committed to helping our technicians grow their skills and build long-term careers.Through a structured technical development pathway, you'll have access to ongoing learning, specialist roadside training and opportunities to achieve industry-recognised IMI accreditation. Whether you're looking to broaden your expertise or continue developing your diagnostic capability, we'll support you every step of the way.

About the role

As a Roadside Technician within our Patrol division, you’ll deliver expert mechanical roadside repair, vehicle diagnostics, and emergency breakdown support across the UK. Whether it’s a flat battery, tyre change, or complex fault-finding, you’ll provide quick, confident solutions and reassurance when our members need it most.

You'll work independently to diagnose faults, solve problems and help members continue their journeys safely. Every day brings different challenges, new environments and the opportunity to make an immediate impact when people need the RAC most.

You'll combine technical expertise with great customer service, using the latest diagnostic technology to identify faults and get members back on the road quickly and safely.

You'll be trusted to make decisions, supported to develop your skills and equipped with everything you need to succeed.

If you're looking for greater variety, more autonomy and a career that takes your skills beyond the workshop; this is the role for you.

As a Roadside Technician at RAC, you’ll get benefits that go the extra mile:

• Strong base pay – £36,400 and realistic OTE of £61,000, with top-performers earning significantly more through bonuses and enhanced overtime rates
• Share in our success – Join our colleague share scheme for free to benefit from the future growth of the business
• Free RAC Ultimate breakdown cover – From your very first day
• Car salary sacrifice scheme – Includes electric vehicle options (after 12 months) to help you save on tax
• Generous holidays – 23 days plus bank holidays (rising to 25 with service)
• Pension & life cover – Up to 6.5% matched pension contributions and life cover up to 4x your salary (10x with flex benefits)
• Wellbeing support – 24/7 confidential support helpline for you and your family
• Exclusive discounts – Save on tools, tech, holidays, and more through our Orange Savings portal

Why RAC?

For more than 128 years, we’ve been keeping drivers moving, and today we’re trusted by over 15 million members. We’re also trusted by our people, with a 4.5-star Glassdoor rating showing that RAC is a place where support, ambition, and opportunity go hand in hand.

We welcome people from every background, value every voice, and back your growth every step of the way. At the RAC, you can bring your full self to work and we’ll be with you every step of the way to help you grow and develop your career.

description:

AAT Finance Officer:

title: Payroll Officer
description:
Payroll Officer

Location: Blackwood

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000

Working Pattern: Full time

Take the next step in your payroll career

Are you an experienced payroll professional looking for a role where your attention to detail, payroll expertise and ability to deliver accurate results are genuinely valued?

We're delighted to be recruiting for a Payroll Officer on behalf of a well-established organisation based in Blackwood.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive, established team and take ownership of the payroll process from start to finish. You'll play an important role in ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time, while providing a professional and responsive payroll service across the organisation.

If you're confident managing payroll, enjoy working with detail and take pride in getting things right, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As Payroll Officer, you'll take responsibility for the end-to-end monthly payroll process, ensuring payroll is accurate, timely and fully compliant with current legislation and company procedures.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Processing monthly payroll from start to finish.
• Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee payroll records.
• Processing starters, leavers, salary changes and contractual amendments.
• Calculating PAYE, National Insurance, pension contributions and other deductions.
• Processing statutory payments, including SSP and SMP where applicable.
• Responding to payroll queries and resolving issues promptly and professionally.
• Completing payroll reconciliations and investigating and resolving discrepancies.
• Preparing payroll reports and supporting statutory submissions.
• Liaising with HMRC, pension providers and other relevant third parties.
• Supporting payroll year-end activities, including the production of P60s.
• Keeping up to date with changes to payroll legislation and ensuring ongoing compliance.
• Handling sensitive employee information with the highest level of confidentiality.

About You

We're looking for a reliable, organised and detail-focused payroll professional who is comfortable working to deadlines and taking ownership of their workload.

You'll ideally have:

• Previous experience working in a payroll role, with end-to-end payroll experience highly desirable.
• A strong understanding of UK payroll legislation, including PAYE, National Insurance and workplace pensions.
• Excellent attention to detail and a consistently high level of accuracy.
• Strong organisational and time-management skills.
• The ability to prioritise effectively and manage competing deadlines.
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
• Experience using payroll software and Microsoft Excel.
• A professional, discreet and confidential approach to sensitive employee information.

A recognised payroll qualification, such as CIPP, would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?

• £28,000 - £30,000 salary
• The opportunity to join a well-established organisation.
• A supportive and collaborative team environment.
• The opportunity to take ownership of an important payroll function.
• A chance to develop and progress your payroll career within an established organisation.

Ready for your next payroll opportunity?

title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Manufacturing Engineering Manager to join a global aerospace engineering and manufacturing organisation.

The business operates in a technically advanced manufacturing environment, producing highly engineered products for the aerospace sector. With a strong focus on quality, operational performance and engineering excellence, this is a business investing heavily in its people, processes and manufacturing capability.

This is a key leadership position, managing a team and playing a major role in improving how products are introduced, manufactured and continuously improved.

Manufacturing Engineering Manager

Permanent

Monday to Thursday, 8:00am – 4:30pm, Friday, 8:00am – 3:30pm

Very Competitive Salary on Offer + 15% Bonus

Coventry

The Role

You will take ownership of the Manufacturing Engineering function, providing direction to a large technical team while working closely with the wider site leadership team.

The role is particularly focused on NPI, manufacturing improvement, Lean and cost reduction, with the successful candidate expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency and develop the site's manufacturing capability.

You will also need to be comfortable operating close to the shop floor, using your technical manufacturing knowledge to support the team and tackle complex production challenges.

Manufacturing Engineering Manager

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop a team of approximately 20, creating a strong culture of ownership, development and continuous improvement.
• Take a leading role in new product introduction, ensuring new products can be manufactured effectively, consistently and commercially.
• Identify and deliver cost-saving and efficiency opportunities, improving processes while maintaining the required standards of quality and performance.
• Drive Lean and continuous improvement activity, focusing on areas such as productivity, waste reduction, process stability, OEE and manufacturing flow.
• Provide technical leadership across manufacturing processes, with a strong understanding of machining, tooling, equipment and production methods.
• Work collaboratively with Engineering, Production, Quality, Supply Chain and Operations to resolve issues and deliver site-wide improvements.
• Support the development of manufacturing strategies, equipment requirements and process improvements to increase future manufacturing capability.
• Establish clear priorities for the engineering team and ensure projects and improvement activities are delivered against agreed business objectives.

Manufacturing Engineering Manager

What We're Looking For

• We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with genuine manufacturing engineering experience.
• A solid background in Manufacturing, Industrial or Process Engineering.
• Strong practical knowledge of machining and precision manufacturing.
• Experience managing and developing a sizeable engineering team.
• A proven background in NPI / industrialisation within a manufacturing environment.
• Practical experience implementing Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement.
• A track record of delivering cost reduction and productivity improvements.
• The ability to understand technical manufacturing problems and provide commercially sensible solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders across engineering, operations and senior leadership.
• Experience within aerospace or another highly regulated engineering environment would be advantageous.

Manufacturing Engineering Manager

Package & Benefits

• 15% Annual bonus
• Focused career development planning and progression opportunities
• Pension scheme with up to 10% company contribution
• Income protection scheme
• Life assurance of 4x basic salary
• Share purchase scheme
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
• Option to buy or sell up to 5 additional days' holiday
• Additional service-related holiday entitlement
• Cash Plan or Private Medical Cover
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Employee discounts across a wide range of goods and services
• Employee referral scheme
• Free on-site parking
• Early finish every Friday

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is much more than a traditional Manufacturing Engineering management position. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a significant engineering function, develop a team and make a measurable difference to manufacturing performance.

The role would suit a hands-on Manufacturing Engineering leader who enjoys developing people, improving processes and getting involved in the technical detail when required.

description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Head of Quality to join a global engineering and manufacturing organisation operating within the highly regulated aerospace sector.

The business designs and manufactures highly engineered products for demanding aerospace applications, operating within a quality-critical environment where product integrity, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement are fundamental to its success.

This is a senior leadership position and a key member of the Site Leadership Team, with responsibility for leading the Quality function and shaping the quality strategy across the division.

Coventry

The Role

As Head of Quality, you will take overall responsibility for the Quality function at site level, leading a team of 12 direct reports and working closely with the wider Senior Leadership Team to drive quality performance, compliance and continuous improvement.

You will be responsible for maintaining and developing an effective Quality Management System, ensuring alignment with customer and regulatory requirements while embedding a strong culture of quality throughout the operation.

This is a role for someone who can operate strategically at SLT level but is equally comfortable getting into the detail when required.

Head of Quality

• Own and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with aerospace, customer and regulatory requirements.

• Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Programme Management and customers to resolve issues and prevent recurrence.

Head of Quality

What We're Looking For

• Proven experience leading a Quality function within an engineering/manufacturing environment.
• Experience managing and developing Quality teams.
• Strong knowledge of AS9100/AS9110 and relevant aerospace regulatory requirements.
• Experience with Quality Management Systems, audits, corrective action and continuous improvement.
• Strong knowledge of Quality tools such as FMEA, MSA, SPC, PPAP, APQP and 8D.
• Experience of project and change management.

title: Store Manager
description:
Would you like to make an impact by leading one of our fashion store teams that are community based, offer amazing choice and genuine sustainability?

Candidate must be fully flexible to work across 7 days per week including Weekends and Bank Holidays.

What does this role involve?

As a Store Manager you will be accountable for your stores performance, maximising sales through physical and digital channels, and achieving store targets by leading an inclusive and diverse team that consistently demonstrate the BHF values .

Each day is different in this varied, fast paced and hands on role. Due to the volume of collections, deliveries and donations, it can be physically demanding at times, yet most rewarding as you play a part in helping to fund life saving research.

What are we looking for?

• Experience working in a customer facing role in retail, hospitality or service industry
• Experience of leading, motivating and developing teams
• Commercial awareness
• Ability to achieve sales targets
• Committed to achieving the highest retail standards at all times
• Able to work under own initiative and take a proactive approach to changing business needs and objectives
• Thrives working in a hands on, fast-paced environment
• An understanding of budgets and P&L

Our stores are fast-paced and trade 7 days a week which means we require flexibility from our store teams to work weekends and bank holidays on a rota basis.

What’s important to us?

At the British Heart Foundation (BHF) we offer a huge range of new and used quality furniture, clothing, jewellery and more, available in store and online.

Our vision is a world where everyone has a healthier heart for longer. We'll get there by funding cutting-edge research and innovation, which hold the keys to saving and improving more lives.

In addition to raising funds for the BHF, we connect with our local communities and help reduce clothing and furniture waste across the UK. With over 700 stores we make a huge environmental impact by preventing around 70,000 tonnes of unwanted items going to landfill every year. We receive 1.6 million items donated to our home stores and 9.8 million bags of donated items and we will continue to build upon our reuse agenda in the years to come.

Belonging at BHF

We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Embracing different perspectives and backgrounds strengthens our organisation and empowers us to make a real difference together.

title: Sales Representative - Christmas Temp

Our goal is simple: to help dogs live healthier, happier, and longer lives, while leaving humans smiling after every interaction.

We’ve come a long way since our co-founders (Kev & Dave), hand delivered the very first Butternut Box. Today, we feed hundreds of thousands of hungry dogs across the UK and Europe - but we won’t stop until we’re feeding dogs everywhere. To get there, we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition to come and work for us.

Are you a fun, vibrant, dog lover and want to earn £45,000+ per Annum Realistic OTE, looking for a Christmas Temp role? This could be the perfect role for you! We are looking for tenacious, animal-loving sales representatives to join our high performing sales team as a Christmas Temp.

We offer a genuinely supportive working environment and want driven individuals who match our passion and ethos. Top performers in the role are currently earning £85,000+ Per Annum.

The best part? You'll be contracted to work 16 day shifts per month till the end of the year— giving you more time for life, while still building a brilliant, high-earning career.

In this role, you'll represent Butternut Box at face-to-face selling opportunities across Belfast and surrounding areas. Activations include shopping centres, food festivals, county shows, Christmas markets, exhibitions, dog shows and more.

• You’ll be attending events selling Butternut Box across the region, stopping potential customers and pitching our offering to them
• The majority of locations will be within 90 minutes of Belfast. Any travel outside of 1 hour, mileage will be paid. Any travel 2 hours+, accommodation will be provided

?? What we're looking for:

• Must be 18 years old or older
• Hardworking and driven by sales
• Confident in large spaces and big crowds
• Have amazing interpersonal skills
• You’re a huge dog lover, of course!

• Initial Butternut Box Sales Pitch

?? Our benefits:

• 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays) and an additional day for every year of service up to 5 years
• 5 additional, paid 'paws' days off per year dedicated to your learning, development or personal wellbeing. Hit pause when you need it most
• £250 personal learning & development budget to sharpen your skills

• Enhanced parental leave
• Flexible core working hours
• Cycle to work scheme
• Pension with NEST

• Private Dental Insurance with Bupa

•
We’re a small (but mighty!) recruitment team. We aim to respond to everyone personally, but if we’re flooded with brilliant applications, we may need to close the role early. We appreciate your patience while we review applications.

•
For this specific role, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so you’ll need the right to work in the UK.

Butternut Box is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that to make the best food for all dogs, we need a team that represents all humans. We celebrate different nationalities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We are specifically committed to increasing representation from underrepresented groups. We want a strong, diverse team built from different identities and lived experiences. title: Senior NPI Engineer
description:
What You Will Do

As a Senior NPI (New Product Introduction) Project Engineer within the ACVS NPI team, you will lead the successful introduction of new PC, workstation, server and storage-based products into manufacturing. Acting as the key technical interface between engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain and customers, you will manage projects from design transfer through validation, production launch and volume ramp-up. This role combines technical expertise in computer hardware platforms with strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary
• 22 days holiday plus bank holidays
• Pension scheme
• Life assurance
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Employee referral scheme
• Employee discounts
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Discounts on Johnson Controls products
• Ongoing training and career development opportunities
• Supportive, collaborative and safety-driven culture

How You Will Do It

• Lead NPI activities for desktop PCs, workstations, rack servers, blade servers and storage systems.
• Manage product introductions from engineering builds through production release and ramp-up.
• Develop and execute project plans, launch schedules and milestone tracking.
• Coordinate Design Validation Testing (DVT) and Production Validation Testing (PVT).
• Ensure manufacturing readiness and successful product launches.
• Review system designs for manufacturability (DFM) and assembly optimisation.
• Evaluate hardware compatibility across motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage, GPUs, power supplies and networking components.
• Support root cause analysis of hardware, firmware and manufacturing issues.
• Drive resolution of technical challenges with engineering and manufacturing teams.
• Monitor project risks, costs, deliverables and timelines.
• Lead cross-functional meetings and provide regular stakeholder updates.
• Manage engineering change notices (ECNs), change requests and product revisions using Windchill.
• Create and validate manufacturing work instructions, assembly processes and test strategies.
• Support process qualification, yield improvement and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Coordinate BOM reviews, component qualification and supplier readiness activities.
• Ensure compliance with relevant standards including CE, UL, FCC, RoHS and REACH.
• Lead corrective and preventive action activities to improve quality and reliability.

What We Are Looking For

Required

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience in NPI engineering, manufacturing engineering, project engineering, systems integration or PC/server manufacturing environments.
• Strong knowledge of PC architecture, enterprise server platforms and system integration.
• Understanding of BIOS/UEFI systems, hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting.
• Knowledge of storage technologies including SATA, SAS and NVMe.
• Experience of product validation, test methodologies and process control.
• Strong project management, planning and organisational skills.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

Beneficial

• Experience with PCBA board builds and electronic assemblies.
• Knowledge of PLM and ERP systems, particularly Windchill.
• Experience driving Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement projects.
• Familiarity with supplier qualification and alternate sourcing processes.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel and Word.
• Customer-focused mindset with strong decision-making capability in a fast-paced environment.
